requirements_summary.summary: Participium is a web application for the Municipality of Turin enabling citizens to report urban issues (e.g., potholes, trash) via an interactive map or Telegram bot. Reports undergo a lifecycle from submission and approval by a Public Relations Officer to assignment, execution (by internal staff or external maintainers), and resolution. The system supports anonymity, multi-channel notifications (platform, email, Telegram), internal coordination between technical offices and external partners, and detailed public/private statistics.

requirements.text:
As an unregistered user
I want to see approved reports on an interactive map 
So that I can know about issues in my area and beyond.
expected_behaviors: I can know about issues in my area and beyond

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member
I want to assign reports to external maintainers
So that specialized maintainers can handle and update the intervention.
constraints: It can be possible for specific reports of certain categories (e.g., Enel X for category Public Lighting) based on their content reviewed by the technical office staff member.
expected_behaviors: specialized maintainers can handle and update the intervention

requirements.text:
As an external maintainer 
I want to update the status of a report assigned to me
So that I can updated citizens about  the intervention.
expected_behaviors: I can updated citizens about  the intervention

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member/external maintainer
I want to exchange information and comments on the report internally
So that coordination happens without exposing internal notes to citizens
expected_behaviors: coordination happens without exposing internal notes to citizens

requirements.text:
As a citizen
I want to register with my name and username 
So that I can access the Participium system and submit reports.
constraints: Registration is required before submitting reports.
expected_behaviors: I can access the Participium system and submit reports

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to confirm my registration with a code
So that my account becomes valid and I can start using the system.
constraints: Once a registration is completed, the user gets an email with a confirmation code. The person can use the application only after confirming by entering the code valid for 30 minutes.
expected_behaviors: my account becomes valid and I can start using the system

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to set up municipality users
constraints: These are the internal accounts of the municipality

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to assign roles to municipality users
constraints: Possible roles: municipal public relations officer, municipal administrator, technical office staff member, external maintainer. You can be more specific on technical offices to run realisti scenarios following the official organizational structure of the municipality of Turin (https://trasparenza.comune.torino.it/media/2212/download)

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to provide details for my report 
So that the the problem is classified correctly.
constraints: Mandatory fields: title, description,  category , photos (min 1 max 3).
expected_behaviors: the the problem is classified correctly

requirements.text:
As a municipal public relations officer
I want to review and approve or reject reports 
So that only valid reports are processed further.
constraints: Rejected reports must include an explanation. If accepted, the report is assigned to the technical office bound to the report category.
expected_behaviors: only valid reports are processed further

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to see approved reports on an interactive map 
So that I can know about issues in my area and beyond.
constraints: Map should be zoomable. When zooming out, reports can be grouped into a cumulative report for a better visualization (total number should be reported on the cumulative report). When zooming in,  reports can be seen separated, with their title and reporter name (or "anonymous" if this is flagged on that report).
expected_behaviors: I can know about issues in my area and beyond

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member
I want to see the list of reports assigned to me
So that I can get an overview of the maintenance to be done
expected_behaviors: I can get an overview of the maintenance to be done

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to configure my account
So that I can better manage notifications and my virtual presence.
constraints: Citizens can  upload a personal photo, add their Telegram username and switch off/on email notifications in the configuration panel.
expected_behaviors: I can better manage notifications and my virtual presence

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to modify roles to municipality users
So that the staff can be more flexible.
constraints: This story overwrites a previous answer given by PO on the Telegram chat. NB: 1) A municipality user can now have multiple roles, i.e. serving on more than one technical office. 2) Modification includes cancellation.
expected_behaviors: the staff can be more flexible

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member 
I want to update report statuses 
So that citizens are informed of the problem resolution process.
constraints: At each status change, the citizen receives notification in the platform with the corresponding update. Municipal operators working on reports can also send messages to the citizens in the platform, to which the citizen can reply.
expected_behaviors: citizens are informed of the problem resolution process

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to reply to messages from municipal operators in the platform 
So that I can communicate directly about my report.
constraints: Two-way communication is possible within the platform.
expected_behaviors: I can communicate directly about my report

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to receive optional email alerts in addition to platform notifications 
So that I can choose the best way to stay updated.
constraints: Unless disabled in their configuration panel.
expected_behaviors: I can choose the best way to stay updated

requirements.text:
As a municipal administrator
I want to configure automatic assignment of all reports in a certain category
So that interventions will be faster.

As a citizen/unregistered user
I want to browse a summary table of reports with filters 
So that I can easily explore and analyze existing reports.
constraints: Filters: by category, status, period of time
expected_behaviors: I can easily explore and analyze existing reports

domain_rules: Reports must be in 'Pending Approval' state until the Organization Office performs preliminary verification.
Accepted reports move to 'Assigned' state and are sent to the competent technical office based on category.
Rejected reports require a mandatory explanation from the Municipality Organization Office.
Once submitted, a report cannot be modified or deleted by the citizen.
Anonymous user's name is visible to staff but hidden in the public Turin map of reports for citizens.
Only technical office staff members can have multiple roles.
External maintainers are added by the system administrator and must have their own individual account.
Automatic assignment of all issues of a certain category is possible only if previously set by the municipal administrator.
Case 1 (External maintainer has access): Internal notes exchanged between technical office and external maintainer are report-specific and reserved (not visible to reporter/citizens).
Case 2 (External maintainer has no access): Communication happens outside Participium; technical office updates status to 'Resolved' when issue is solved.
Public statistics include number of reports by category and trends by day/week/month.
Private statistics (admin only) include detailed breakdowns by status, type, reporter, and combinations including top 1% and 5% reporters.
Notifications/messages can be set to either real-time or on page refresh depending on preference.
edge_cases: User attempts to submit a report without registration: System blocks submission until registration is confirmed.
Confirmation code expires (30 minutes): User cannot activate account and must re-register.
Report submitted with 0 photos or >3 photos: Form validation prevents submission.
Citizen tries to edit/delete their own report after submission: System denies action.
External maintainer attempts to view internal comments from technical office staff: System hides these comments.
User follows a closed (Resolved/Rejected) report: System prevents following or stops notifications.

Admin modifies roles of a 'technical office staff member' who already has multiple roles: System enforces constraint that only this role allows multiple assignments, potentially requiring re-evaluation if logic changes.
Download CSV with active filters: System exports only the filtered subset of data.
assumptions: The 'Organization Office' refers to the initial review team before assignment.
Competent technical office is determined by the problem category (e.g., Public Lighting -> Enel X or specific office).
Telegram bot integration requires users to have a valid Telegram username configured in their profile.
Email notifications are sent unless explicitly disabled in the user's configuration panel.
The 'top 1% of reporters' statistic implies ranking by volume of reports submitted.
Unregistered users can view maps and statistics but cannot submit reports or follow reports.
External maintainers without system access update status via external channels, requiring manual status transition by technical office staff.

risks: Public endpoints (/users, /reports/active, /categories, /external-company*) may expose sensitive user or company data without authentication.
Verification flow lacks explicit error handling for expired codes or multiple attempts in documentation.
Admin endpoints do not specify required role claims beyond 'auth_required', risking privilege escalation if JWT validation is weak.
Technician and Officer endpoints share similar paths but different tags; client must enforce role-based routing to prevent unauthorized access.
External company assignment (/technician/reports/{id}/external) lacks documentation on external maintainer verification or approval workflow.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Unregistered user can view approved reports on an interactive map.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute GET /reports/active without authentication. Verify that the response contains a list of reports filtered to only those with status 'Approved' or equivalent public-visible states. Ensure no internal notes or sensitive reporter data (like full name if anonymous) are exposed in the payload.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the core public-facing functionality for unregistered users as per PT28.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Technical office staff member assigns reports to external maintainers.
strategy_items.prompt: 1. Login as a 'technical office staff member' role. 2. Ensure a report exists in 'Assigned' state. 3. Execute PATCH /technician/reports/{id}/external with payload setting the external maintainer ID. 4. Verify the response indicates successful assignment and the report status reflects the delegation.
setup_needed: POST /login with technical office staff credentials
POST /reports (to create a report in 'Pending Approval' or 'Assigned' state if not pre-existing)
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete it if unexpectedly present. Note: This endpoint modifies state, so ensure the external assignment is rolled back or verified as completed before cleanup logic applies to the specific test artifact.
strategy_items.rationale: Tests the primary workflow for PT24 regarding external maintainer assignment.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Unregistered user attempts to view reports with sensitive data exposed.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute GET /reports/active without authentication. Verify that the response does NOT contain internal notes, full names of anonymous reporters, or any data marked as private. Ensure only approved reports are returned.
strategy_items.rationale: Tests the domain rule regarding anonymous user visibility and data privacy (Domain Rule: Anonymous user's name is visible to staff but hidden in public Turin map).

strategy_items.requirement_summary: External maintainer attempts to view internal comments from technical office staff.
strategy_items.prompt: 1. Login as an 'external maintainer'. 2. Ensure a report exists with internal comments added by a 'technical office staff member' (via PT26 setup). 3. Execute GET /reports/{id}/comments. 4. Verify that the response does NOT contain the internal comments added by the technical office staff.
setup_needed: Ensure report exists and has internal comments from a different role (technical office staff)
strategy_items.rationale: Tests the domain rule regarding visibility of internal notes to external maintainers (Domain Rule: Case 1/Case 2).

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen registers with name and username to access the system.
strategy_items.prompt: Register a new citizen user with a valid name, unique username, and email. Ensure the response includes the verification code or token required for subsequent activation.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the core registration flow required for all citizen interactions.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen confirms registration with a code to activate account.
strategy_items.prompt: Verify the user account using the valid confirmation code received during registration. Ensure the account status changes to 'active' and JWT is issued upon success.
setup_needed: Execute POST /register to obtain a user ID and verification code.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the critical account activation step before any report submission can occur.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen provides details for their report so that the problem is classified correctly.
strategy_items.prompt: Submit a new report with valid title, description, category, and location. Ensure the report is created in 'Pending Approval' state as per domain rules.
setup_needed: Execute POST /register to create a user.
Execute POST /users/{id}/verify/check with valid code to activate the user.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; if report exists, delete it using an admin endpoint or verify system handles cleanup automatically.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the core reporting functionality and initial state management.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: System administrator sets up municipality users.
strategy_items.prompt: Register a new municipality user via the admin endpoint. Ensure the user is created with appropriate default roles or pending role assignment.
setup_needed: Execute POST /login as a system administrator to obtain an admin JWT.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: DELETE the created user via an admin endpoint.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the administrative capability to onboard new staff members.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: System administrator assigns roles to municipality users.
strategy_items.prompt: Assign a specific role (e.g., 'technical office staff') to an existing municipality user. Verify the role assignment is successful and reflected in the user's profile.
setup_needed: Execute POST /admin/register to create a test user.
Execute POST /login as a system administrator.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: DELETE the created user via an admin endpoint.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the core administrative function of role assignment.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Municipal public relations officer reviews and approves or rejects reports.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a stateful workflow test where an officer attempts to approve a report that has already been approved. Verify the system handles this gracefully (e.g., idempotency or error indicating state change is not possible).
setup_needed: POST /login with credentials for a user having role 'municipal public relations officer' to obtain JWT.
Ensure a report exists in 'Pending Approval' state.
Execute the happy path approval test (from item 1) on this same report ID to transition it to 'Assigned'.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was modified incorrectly; ensure subsequent tests use fresh data or verify the specific report ID used.
strategy_items.rationale: Tests the state transition logic to ensure idempotency or proper error handling when re-applying an action.
